Mary Francisco died 1808 Kent Co., DE Probate Records

Administration Bond granted Nov, 29th 1808 {excerpt: Administration on the above estate was granted to John Marin(?), Administrator, who posted one thousand dollars bond. Also signing were Thomas Fisher and Nath'l Smithers, Register.} Inventory of Mary Sisco, 1808 An Inventory of the Goods and Chattels of Mary Cisco Dec'd, Appraised by Wm. Harper Senr. & Charles Harper this 4th day of Decm. 1808. Wearing Apparel $36 Dollars 1 1/2 lbs hackled flax 00.30 2 1.2 yds. Seven Hundred Linen 01.00 Cash 01.31 1 Chest 02.00 1 Trunk 01.00 $41.61 (signed) William Harper Senr. Charles Harper Admin. Account - Mary Francisco, Dec'd - April 30th 1817 To John Clarke Register for Kent County: Hannah Marin Administrator of John Marin Esqr. who was Admn. of Mary Fransisco Dec'd Presents the following Acct. of Johns Admin. on the Said Mary's Estate for Adjustment. THE ESTATE OF THE DECEASED Nov. 29 1808 To Cash Paid for Letters Testamentary - 2.17 To the Funeral Expenses - 16.85 19.05 To Interest on the Sums from 29th of November 1809 to 30th of April 1817. 7 yrs. 5 percent 8.43 To Commissions on 345 Dollars (unclear) 34.60 To the Register for this Account 2.14 64.19 To a Ballance Unappropriated 281.76 Note this Ballance is (unclear) in the 3rd Administration acct. Passed on the Estate of John Marin, Esqr. on this date. CONTRA Nov. 29 1808 By the amount of Inventory (unclear) 41.61 1809 By Cash from James Selby 207.54 By Interest from 29th of November 1809 to 30th of April 1817 7 years and 5 Months 96.80 345.95 Examined Adjusted Proved and Settled this 30th of April 1817. (signed) John Clarke, Reg.
